content.title: Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (March 28, 2026)
content.text: The Cleveland Guardians and Seattle Mariners are set to face off in a tightly contested matchup, both teams currently holding a 1-1 record. The Mariners enter this game on a one-game winning streak, while the Guardians are looking to break a one-game losing streak. Seattle’s offensive leaders include Luke Raley, who boasts a .333 batting average and leads the team with three RBIs and two home runs. On the mound, George Kirby has been effective with a 1.50 ERA and one win. Conversely, the Guardians’ standout is Chase DeLauter, who is hitting .500 with three home runs and four runs scored. Tanner Bibee leads the Guardians’ pitching staff with seven strikeouts, although he carries a 5.40 ERA. Both teams will aim to capitalize on their strengths as they continue their early-season campaigns.
